options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: bind_password
options.description: Password to use when binding a new LDAP session. Mandatory for the create operation.

options.name: bind_user
options.description: Distinguished Name (DN) of the user to be used when binding; that is, authenticating and setting up the connection to the LDAP server. Mandatory for the create operation.

options.name: is_global_catalog
options.description: Whether or not the catalog is global.

options.name: ldap_domain_group_settings
options.description: Group settings of LDAP domain.

options.name: ldap_domain_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the LDAP domain configuration.

options.name: ldap_domain_name
options.description: Name of the LDAP authority to construct the LDAP server configuration. Mandatory for the create operation.

options.name: ldap_domain_user_settings
options.description: User settings of LDAP domain.

options.name: ldap_server_port
options.description: Port number used to connect to the LDAP Server.

options.name: ldap_server_state
options.description: State of the LDAP server. The I(ldap_servers) and I(ldap_server_state) are required together.

options.name: ldap_server_type
options.description: Types of the LDAP server.

options.name: ldap_servers
options.description: List of IP addresses of the LDAP servers for the domain.

options.name: ldap_timeout
options.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to an LDAP server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Types of directory service protocol.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the LDAP domain configuration should exist or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For all other operations except delete, it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: verify_configuration
options.description: Indicates whether to perform the verify LDAP domain configuration or not.
